messages:
elaine: Quick check — service-account / OIDC / JWT scoping differences across SDKs? I'm seeing tokens from the Node helper that omit the project/org claim, but the Python helper includes it. Anyone seen inconsistent claims between libs?

sam: Hmm — can you paste the exact call you make in Node vs Python? Could be `scope` vs `audience` semantics.

elaine: Node: calling our `saClient.createJwt({ scopes: ['openid','email'] })` (no audience). Decoded JWT has no `project` or `org` claim. Python: `sa.get_jwt(scopes=['openid','email'])` — decoded token includes `x_project` claim.

ajay: Are these Google-style SAs or our internal OIDC issuer? Implementation details differ. Our internal OIDC will emit extra claims only when `audience` is set to a project-scoped value.

sam: Also worth noting a streaming quirk — Node SDK previously failed to refresh auth mid-stream. Did you hit 401s during long streams or only immediately?

elaine: Hit a 401 after ~55 minutes on a long-live stream. Python auto-refreshed the bearer and continued. Node errored out.

devex-bot: CI note — opened RFC #4126 tracking stream reauth hooks (link: https://rfd.redwood/4126).

ajay: Quick diagnostic: dump the JWT payload and check `aud` + custom claims. Our helper will omit `project` unless `audience: 'redwood:project'` or `scope` includes `redwood:project:read`.

sam: Workaround for Node streaming: pass an auth-refresh callback rather than a static header. Example pattern we used:

const authProvider = async () => `Bearer ${await getFreshToken()}`;
streamClient.open({ headers: { Authorization: await authProvider() }, authRefresh: authProvider });

That lets the runtime swap headers without reconnecting. We'll add a first-class API for this.

elaine: Good call — I can patch the app to use that. Also planning a small SDK PR so the high-level `stream()` accepts `authRefresh`. @ajay can you take a look when I open it?

ajay: Yep — ping me. I'll also add an SDK unit test that simulates token rotation mid-stream.

sam: On the scoping mismatch: our Python helper currently derives audience differently (it uses `target_audience` param when available). Node was defaulting to scopes-only. We'll standardize to prefer explicit `audience` if present, otherwise fall back to scopes.

elaine: Will add a regression test that decodes tokens and asserts `project` claim present when `audience` set. Also adding an entry to devex docs about `authRefresh` for streams.

devex-bot: CI trigger: branch ela/auth-refresh, tests queued.

elaine: Thanks all :thumbsup:
